candidate_concepts.label: Project-Based Learning (PBL)
candidate_concepts.description: A pedagogical method where students learn by doing real projects proposed by companies, used throughout Inteli's curriculum.
coverage_criteria: Define what PBL stands for and summarize how it is applied at Inteli.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The source repeatedly and explicitly describes Inteli's methodology as 'Aprendizagem Baseada em Projetos (PBL)', details how students face real challenges from companies, and positions it as the core pedagogical approach.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: PBL is a well-defined educational method that can be assessed by a student's ability to explain its key characteristics and application, making it a single, checkable concept.

source_anchors.locator: Por meio da Aprendizagem Baseada em Projetos (PBL), nossos alunos enfrentam desafios reais...

candidate_concepts.label: MEC Maximum Grade Recognition
candidate_concepts.description: Inteli received the maximum grade (nota máxima) from Brazil's Ministry of Education (MEC) for all five of its graduation courses, validating its quality.
coverage_criteria: State what is the highest MEC grade and list the five graduation courses that earned it at Inteli.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The source prominently displays '5 vezes nota máxima no MEC' and explains that this recognition attests to the quality of the pedagogical model, infrastructure, and faculty.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: This is a specific institutional achievement that can be verified through recall of facts, making it an appropriately sized concept.

candidate_concepts.label: Career, Leadership and Employability (CDL) Center
candidate_concepts.description: Inteli has a dedicated center (CDL) that provides personalized mentoring, career preparation, and a curriculum focused on soft skills, strategic vision, and decision-making from the start of the course.
coverage_criteria: Explain the three pillars of the CDL and describe what services it offers to students.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The source explicitly states that Inteli is the only Brazilian college with a team of specialists dedicated to career development from day one, and the CDL focuses on leadership, soft skills, and strategic vision.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: The CDL is a distinct institutional feature with clear components, small enough to be tested with a few recall or summary questions.

source_anchors.locator: Carreira, Liderança e Empregabilidade: três pilares, um só destino

candidate_concepts.label: Protagonism with Three Trails
candidate_concepts.description: In the fourth year, Inteli students choose one of three trails (Empreendedora, Acadêmica, or Corporativa) with institutional support to align their education with their career goals.
coverage_criteria: List the three available trails and explain the concept of protagonism at Inteli.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The source explicitly states that in the fourth year, students choose a trail that best connects with their future, and Inteli provides mentoring and strategic support.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: This is a specific program structure element that can be memorized and explained succinctly, fitting the candidate concept size.

source_anchors.locator: Protagonismo: você escolhe, o Inteli potencializa

candidate_concepts.label: Company Partnerships and Project Prototypes

coverage_criteria: Recite the quantitative claims about the number of partner companies, prototypes developed, and projects per student.

extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: These numeric facts are discrete and easily checkable with straightforward recall questions.
